intentComment: Story 071 — mainnet differential deploy promoting Story 070's DeployMocks. One atomic Ledger broadcast: (A) replace the three live BurnerV2 dispatchers at NFTMinterV2 indices 1/2/3 (EYE/SCX/FLX) with Uniboost dispatchers (each backed by a live EYE|SCX|FLX/WETH UniV2 pool) + a UniboostMintDebtHook + an NFTStakerDepletion staker, plus a MultiPooler wired as each Uniboost's sole authorized pooler (deployer = MultiPooler.pooler); MANDATORY setPrice(idx,10e6)+setGrowthFactor(idx,2) after each replaceDispatcher because replaceDispatcher preserves the burners' 18-dp price; (B) swap the index-7 dispatcher to NudgeRatchetDelayRelease (deployer whitelisted releaser) with a fresh NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook, drain-first via RatchetNFTStaker.pullAndRefresh(), repoint the existing RatchetNFTStaker, decommission the old ratchet hook (index-7 price/growth left UNTOUCHED at 70e6/0). :dry runs PREVIEW_MODE (no broadcast, no progress file). :broadcast backs up addresses -> Ledger broadcast -> patch. Does NOT run pool() (thin real USDC pools). Owner 0xCad1..D0B6.

dry.semantics: PREVIEW_MODE=true: run() reads vm.envOr('PREVIEW_MODE', false)=true, so it vm.startPrank(OWNER_ADDRESS) instead of vm.startBroadcast() (impersonate owner, no signing), and the progress file is NOT written. Phase 0 preconditions + final _verifyFinalState() still execute (read-only). Uses --rpc-url (state read against live mainnet, no fork isolation flag) so this is a live read-only eth_call preview, not a broadcast.

broadcast.nonAtomicNote: This is a NON-ATOMIC multi-transaction sequence, NOT a single atomic on-chain tx. --slow forces forge to submit each broadcast tx and wait for its confirmation before sending the next. --skip-simulation disables the pre-flight simulation (the on-chain state at each step must therefore satisfy the script's own require() guards live). The script writes server/deployments/progress.uniboost-cutover.1.json after every deployment CREATE and every config step so a mid-flight halt (Ledger reject, gas, RPC drop) can be resumed idempotently via the _isDeployed/_isConfigured checkpoint guards. ~12 CREATE txs + ~28 config/mutation txs are broadcast in sequence; a partial run leaves NFTMinterV2 in a mixed state (some indices swapped, some not) until re-run to completion. The docstring's 'one atomic Ledger session' means one signing session, not one transaction.

pre.effect: Copies server/deployments/mainnet-addresses.ts -> server/deployments/mainnet.backup.<ISO-timestamp>.ts (snapshot before mutation). Read-only on the source; write creates a new backup file.

post.when: broadcast only (after forge, && chained so it runs only on forge success)
post.effect: Patches server/deployments/mainnet-addresses.ts in place with the real deployed addresses read from broadcast/DeployMainnetUniboostCutover.s.sol/1/run-latest.json, cross-checked against progress.uniboost-cutover.1.json (deploymentStatus must == 'completed'). Fills 10 zero-address placeholders (update:false, aborts on non-zero collision) and updates 2 live ratchet keys (update:true).

phases: run: config-safety require() guards (price==10e6, growth==2, donationSplit 1..100, depletionWindow 1..120, core addrs != 0)
Phase 0: preconditions (owners == OWNER; configs(1/2/3)==live burners; configs(7)==live NudgeRatchet; ratchetSink==BATCH_NFT_MINTER; 3 pools sane)
Phase 1: deploy+wire Uniboost stack (3x Uniboost+Hook+phUSD.setMinter, MultiPooler, authorize pooler)
Phase 3: Uniboost donation config (recipient=BatchNFTMinter, split=50) + 3x NFTStakerDepletion deploy/wire (setDispatcherHook, hook.setRecipient, setDepletionWindow=12mo, Pauser.register)

Phase 4: index-7 ratchet swap drain-first (pullAndRefresh, deploy NudgeRatchetDelayRelease+hook, setMinter/setReleaser/setHook, phUSD.setMinter, replaceDispatcher(7), repoint RatchetNFTStaker, decommission old hook)

liveProbe.configs(1/2/3/7).dispatcher: 0x13fb51BC.. / 0xA833603f.. / 0xb63b5702.. / 0x7A4eD111.. (== hardcoded BURNER_EYE/SCX/FLX + OLD_NUDGE_RATCHET: all four replace-preconditions hold live)
